column_semantics: The schedule has a Reference Rate and Spread column and an Interest Rate column. The Interest Rate column shows the total stated coupon/rate. For PIK debt, the PIK component is included in the stated spread/rate text, either parenthetically as '(incl ... % PIK)' or as a rate followed by 'PIK'; it is not disclosed as a separate additive cash-leg column.

rationale: The filing does not present separate Cash and PIK rate columns. Instead, PIK is embedded in the printed rate/spread disclosure: floating-rate loans show the spread with '(incl ... % PIK)' and a single Interest Rate total, while fixed PIK notes show a single Interest Rate such as '13.00 % PIK'. This matches an all-in convention for the position-level Interest Rate.
